notes:
=== CONCEPT ===
+trace follows the full DNS resolution chain from root servers through TLD servers to the authoritative nameserver. Shows every delegation hop. Valuable for understanding DNS delegation structure and spotting misconfigurations in the resolution path.

=== WHAT IT REVEALS ===
Root → TLD → authoritative server delegation chain. Which nameservers are authoritative at each level. Delegation misconfigurations (e.g., subdomain delegated to an expired/abandoned NS). Wildcard DNS at any level in the chain.

=== CHAINING ===
dig +trace → identify authoritative NS for each subdomain → test each NS for zone transfer → if different NSes serve different subdomains, each is an individual AXFR target.
